_comment: Mine Site Task Management — Flow 1: Task Initiated
_instructions: This is a reference definition. In Power Automate, build this flow manually using Document 3 as your guide. Replace all [PLACEHOLDER] values with your real tenant/site details before use.

flow.name: MineTasks_Flow1_TaskInitiated
flow.description: Triggered when a new task is created in WorkTasks. Generates a Task ID, notifies the assigned supervisor via Teams and Email, and escalates if Critical priority.

trigger.type: SharePoint - When an item is created

actions.name: GetDepartmentContact
actions.description: Looks up supervisor and manager email from DepartmentContacts list

actions.name: InitializeTaskID
actions.description: Generates a unique Task ID: e.g. LOA-20260609-4821

actions.name: UpdateTaskWithID
actions.description: Writes the generated Task ID and Initiated Date back to the WorkTasks item

actions.name: SendTeamsCardToSupervisor
actions.type: Teams - Post Adaptive Card to user
actions.description: Sends an Adaptive Card to the supervisor via Teams chat
actions.adaptiveCard: See Document 3, Step 7 for the full Adaptive Card JSON

actions.name: SendEmailToSupervisor
actions.description: Sends a formatted HTML email to the assigned supervisor
actions.subject: [ACTION REQUIRED] New Work Task: @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']} — @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Department/Value']}
actions.body: See Document 3, Step 8 for the full HTML email body

actions.name: CheckIfCritical
actions.description: Branches based on whether priority is Critical

yesBranch.name: EscalationEmailToMineManager
yesBranch.subject: [CRITICAL TASK ALERT] @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']}
yesBranch.body: Critical priority task escalation with full task details
